verdict.rationale: Stable offers a nationwide registered agent service that gives digital access to state and legal mail, with routing tools to act on it (stable-docs-27, stable-docs-20). Its docs show adding a registered agent Location to an existing Organization so a company can receive service of process, tied to an existing Company and alongside CMRA mailbox locations (stable-docs-31, stable-docs-5, stable-docs-22). Missing for 10: pricing or plan evidence that registered agent service is bundled with or sold as an add-on to the mailbox plan, details on how service-of-process documents are handled (urgent alerts, forwarding SLAs), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
